title: To the End of the Age

request.style: English, anthemic rock, male and female duet lead vocals with gang vocals, electric guitars, bass, big drums, piano, open and driving, 128 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eleven men went to Galilee, up the mountain path
Where the risen Lord had told them that they'd see his face at last
When they saw him they worshiped him, though some of them still doubted
And Jesus came and spoke to them, and the hills around them sounded

[Pre-Chorus]
All authority in heaven and on earth
Has been given to me

[Chorus]
Therefore go and make disciples of all nations
Baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
Teaching them to keep everything I have commanded you
And remember, I am with you always, to the very end of the age

[Verse]
Not just the strong and not just sure, he sent the ones who doubted
Fishermen and tax collectors, all the ones he'd counted
From the mountain into every town, to every land and nation
The word goes out from Galilee to every generation

[Pre-Chorus]
All authority in heaven and on earth
Has been given to me

[Chorus]
Therefore go and make disciples of all nations
Baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
Teaching them to keep everything I have commanded you
And remember, I am with you always, to the very end of the age

[Bridge]
I am with you always
I am with you always
To the very end of the age

[Outro]
Go and make disciples of all nations
I am with you always
